description: Last stdout line of ``ks verify`` (canonical JSON).

anchored.description:
True iff verify ran with ``--head <RunAnchor>``, the anchor matched, and the run used fresh keys.
The C1 claim (an insider cannot rewrite history undetected) holds **only when anchored** (F1).
anchored.title: Anchored

first_bad.description: seq (= 1-based line number) of the first bad record, or ``None``.
first_bad.title: First Bad

isolation.description:
v1.2: echo of ``RunConfig.isolation``; ``None`` only when config.json could not be read. When
``degraded``, verify prints "per-agent attribution VOID" (SKEL-01 finding 4).
isolation.title: Isolation

last_witnessed_seq.description: Highest seq covered by a valid witness checkpoint (0 = none). Tamper-evident up to here.
last_witnessed_seq.title: Last Witnessed Seq

ok.description: True iff exit code is Exit.OK.
ok.title: Ok

unanchored_reason.description: Why not anchored: no ``--head`` given, or ``key_mode == repro`` (X7/R4). ``None`` iff ``anchored``.
unanchored_reason.title: Unanchored Reason

title: VerifyReport
